module: Small hook-based performance measurement library: while enabled, each Lua function call/return is timed, and per-function statistics are computed over time windows. Loaded with require('utils/perf'). Debugging only, slows execution heavily; can feed the debug UI via a guihooks event.
usage:
local perf = require('utils/perf')
perf.enable(1)
-- code to measure, and perf.update() every frame
perf.disable()
perf.saveDataToCSV('vehicleloading.csv')
notes: enable() replaces any existing debug hook; disable() removes it (debug.sethook()).
M.update is nop until enable() has been called: perf.update() must be called every frame once enabled.
M.data contains {frameCount, size, memory, fcts = {{f=name, t=cumulative time, c=call count, s=score}}} plus the fields of srcData; memory comes from gcinfo().
The score s = t * c / (windowSize * 1000): product of cumulative time x calls (odd formula, inferred from code; it is not a simple average time).
Inconsistency: the default window of enable() is 10 s whereas the module variable windowSize is initialized to 2.
saveDataToCSV writes the header ';function, time' then 'name, score' lines sorted by descending score; returns false if the file cannot be opened, but nothing (nil) on success.

data.desc: Last computed statistics (see notes). Empty until a window has completed.

update.desc: nop while disabled; becomes the update function (to be called every frame) after enable().

_windowSize.desc: Duration of a statistics window in seconds, 10 by default

_guiHook.desc: guihooks.trigger event name to which M.data is sent on each window

_srcData.desc: Fields added as is to M.data

disable.desc: Disables profiling and resets M.update to nop.

getData.desc: Forces the computation of the current window's statistics (and resets the counters), then returns M.data.

saveDataToCSV.desc: Computes the current statistics and writes them to a CSV, sorted by descending score.

returns.desc: false if it cannot be opened, nil otherwise

update.desc: To be called every frame once enabled: counts frames and triggers the statistics computation at each elapsed window. nop if disabled.
